coordinate_frame: Plan image pixels; origin top-left; x right, y down; no camera or world projection applied

method.detection: Closed white component; polygon/radius shape classification; scalloped crown harmonics distinguish tree symbols
method.review: All automatic candidates contact-sheet reviewed; conservative rejected candidates reviewed for actual small crowns; overlapping symbols manually split where visible
limitations: Raster line art is schematic, not a vegetation survey.
Some touching or canvas-clipped crowns have 2px center/radius uncertainty.
Faint/open/occluded crown symbols can remain under-detected; this list contains reviewed positions, not a claim of complete surveyed vegetation.
World mapping must use the new independent plan registration, never the old perspective camera.
